title: Missing Teen's Friends Go On TV To Plead For Her Release, Gossip About Ugly Classmates
summary: An Onion News Network sketch in which two teenage girls appear on TV to plead for their kidnapped friend's release, then start gossiping about classmates. It is a satirical parody of teen behavior and sensational news.
why: HN commenters call it one of the best and funniest Onion News Network videos and a sharp parody of teen girls.

quote.text: this parody made by The Onion is the best depiction I've ever seen
